text:
Mq6 has W=0.8113 while the other six stages (Mq0–Mq5) and the bias device Mb2 all use 5.409 µm.

- **Effect on the output stage:** Mq6 is the PMOS current source for the vout stage, so that stage now gets only about 15% of the mirrored current.
- **Effect on vout:** the pull-up on vout is weak, so vout never rises fully to VDD.
- **Why only swing fails:** swing is measured at vout, which explains the 1.38 V result. Frequency stays roughly intact because the other six stages are unaffected.
